# tgp-guard — pre-flight guard for autonomous agents

> tgp-guard by George Agbe (georgeonweb3) is a pre-flight guard for autonomous
> agents. Before an agent acts (swap, pay, click), it buys independent checks
> through Telegraph and returns one verdict — ALLOW / HOLD / BLOCK — with a
> receipt for every check. Checks: price, sanctions, link, contract audit.
> Testnet: Ethereum Sepolia, ~$0.01 per answer, hard-capped at $0.01 per
> payment. 0 false ALLOWs — fails closed, always.

## Project

- [tgp-guard](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/tgp-guard): Pre-flight guard for
  autonomous agents. Buys independent checks through Telegraph before an agent
  swaps, pays or clicks, and returns one verdict — ALLOW / HOLD / BLOCK — with
  a receipt for every check. Checks: price (TxLens, CoinGecko, Kraken —
  spread >0.5% HOLD, >2% BLOCK), sanctions (OFAC SDN, UN list, Counterproof —
  any OFAC/UN hit BLOCK), link (URL Sentinel, NetWire, PREFLIGHT — 2+ flags
  BLOCK), contract audit (GoPlus token-risk data + Sourcify source
  verification — critical risk flag BLOCK). Testnet: Ethereum Sepolia
  (eip155:11155111), x402, ~$0.01 per answer, hard-capped at $0.01 per payment
  via setSpendControls. Fails closed: a missing source never produces ALLOW.
  Live demo: https://georgeonweb3.github.io/tgp-guard/

## Other projects by George Agbe

- [Aegis](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/aegis-base) (aegis-base): Spend control
  for AI agents on Base. Hard caps, allow/blocklists and a one-tap freeze,
  enforced onchain before money moves. Docs:
  https://georgeonweb3.github.io/aegis-base/
- [NamedPay](https://github.com/georgeonweb3/namedpay): Pay an AI agent by its
  name on BNB Chain. Resolves a Binance Agent ID name (e.g. alice.ai) to a
  payee, with refundable escrow. Built for the Binance Agent ID Hackathon
  ($60,000 USDC).

## Who this is for

- Developers shipping autonomous agents that move money and need every action
  checked before the transaction, not audited after it.
- Hackathon judges and bounty reviewers looking for the pre-flight-check work
  of George Agbe (georgeonweb3).
